requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 TM1637 + 按钮（D2）：每按一次计数+1并显示
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Initialize with io_1=0; apply a single button press to io_0 as a rising edge (false->true) then return to false, with no further presses.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: On the press edge control step, count increments by 1 and io_1 equals the incremented value; after releasing, io_1 remains at that value until the next press edge.
